text:
sasha: Quick launch-day check — quiet period starts in ~45m. Posting the sanity checklist and exceptions here. If you need an exception, reply in the next 20m. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/rel/v3.2.0 :rocket:

release-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed for v3.2.0-canary on prod-north. Summary: error_rate=0.15% | p95=220ms | throughput=120rps. Logs: https://logs.redwood/canary/1823456789

eric: I saw a 500 spike on /v1/embeddings at 14:12 during canary. Not huge but worth flagging. @lena can you check inference pool and memory?

lena: digging in — saw an OOM on gpu-c2-12, autoscaler removed a pod. Scaling pool +1 now and redeploying canary with KV cache enabled. Will report back in ~5m.

sasha: Criteria for green: two consecutive canaries with p95 < 300ms and error < 0.25%. If scaling fixes it, we'll proceed with ramp. Otherwise we hold and trigger rollback. @maria please stage the rollback artifact and keep it ready.

maria: Rollback artifact staged: s3://releases/redwood/v3.1.9-rollback.tar.gz. Rollback playbook snippet: ```# dry-run
release-bot rollback --version v3.1.9 --env prod --dry-run
# to execute
release-bot rollback --version v3.1.9 --env prod``` Docs: https://confluence.redwood/playbooks/rollback

devops-bot: release-bot validated the rollback plan (dry-run passed). Canary trigger command: `/release canary v3.2.0 --env prod --instances 3`

eric: After the scale, second canary run: p95=210ms, error_rate=0.12%, no 5xxs in last 10m. Looks stable. Recommendation: ramp 10% -> 50% -> 100% with a 10m hold at each step and smoke checks at each stage.

sasha: :thumbsup: Proceeding with the ramp as recommended. Everyone watch the #prod-alerts channel during the ramp. Freeze exceptions window still open for 25m; if you need one, say why and include mitigation steps.

lena: I'll tail GPU memory and controller logs. If we see persistent OOMs (>=3 in 15m), trigger rollback. Snippet I used to scale: ```kubectl scale deployment inference-pool --replicas=6 -n prod```

release-bot: changewindow locked until 2026-06-01T15:00:00Z. If rollback occurs, please annotate the incident ID in the release notes.

sasha: Thanks team — I'll update the release notes live with canary telemetry and the ramp timeline. Ping me directly if you observe anything odd.

Note: Keep chat short and use the exception form for formal sign-off: https://forms.redwood/launch-exception
